title: A Schedule Create & Edit only role can open 'Assign existing work order' and the unscheduled work order list loads
custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role that grants only Schedule View and Schedule Create & Edit (no Work Orders access).
  2. The user has a default workplace assigned.
  3. At least one unscheduled work order exists.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as that user and open Schedule.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The day calendar opens (the date header is shown) and the user is not sent to an access-denied page.

custom_steps_separated.content: Left-click an empty time slot to open the schedule menu.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The menu opens and shows 'Assign existing work order' (the create/assign options show because the role has Schedule Create & Edit).
The Assign dialog opens and its unscheduled-work-order list loads with options; the user stays on Schedule and is not sent to an access-denied page.

viu_status: Blocked-UI: the Assign existing work order dialog / unscheduled WO list could not be opened headless (Schedule button + calendar clicks opened no dialog); needs the calendar create-entry interaction in a real browser.
evidence: Reworded; API endpoint jargon stripped. Needs live UI.
